content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial remains after submission with records and a medical-necessity appeal; the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. No coding or COB error supports a corrected claim, and repeating the same rework is unlikely to progress payment. With a secondary payer on file and COB order correct, bill the secondary for adjudication rather than write off the balance or treat the authorization denial as patient liability.","action":"bill_secondary"}
